sellThenNews.description: r/wallstreetbets 2026 年 6 月 12 日情绪分析。讨论最多的股票代码：SPCX、SPCE、RKLB、MSFT、MU。人工智能生成的零售流程、牛市/熊市叙述和关键主题的摘要。

sections.overview:
1. 整体市场概况和情绪

今日主要事件：

  • SpaceX (SPCX), the largest IPO in history, lands on Nasdaq today: Offering price $135, issuing 555.6 million Class A shares, raising approximately $75 billion, with a valuation of $1.77 trillion, making it the largest IPO ever. Nasdaq announced that price indications would begin at 9:50 ET, with official matching confirmed to start at 10:00 ET — meaning as of now (9:41 ET), SPCX has not yet started trading, but the comment section has already been flooded with “when can I buy” posts, with many retail traders mistakenly believing it would be tradable immediately at the open. Hyperliquid OTC perpetual contracts are quoted around $173-180, leading the community to expect a sharply higher open. Elon Musk appeared at Nasdaq wearing the same-style leather jacket as Jensen; if the stock opens at the OTC price, his net worth will exceed $1 trillion.
  • Space sector suffers “siphon-style” bloodbath: On the day the real protagonist lists, all space-concept stocks collectively plunged at the open — SPCE -25.3% ($4.35, with bagholders who bought yesterday’s two intraday spikes getting harvested a second time), LUNR -10.5%, RDW -9.5% (compounded by an offering), ASTS -9.4% ($88.45, dumping after hitting $97 premarket), RKLB -6.6% ($107, flipping from as much as +9% premarket to a deep decline). The community joked: “sell everything to buy SPCX.”
  • Iran deal turns into another Rashomon, “sell the news” plays out: IRGC-linked Fars News denied this morning’s reports of “signing in Geneva on Sunday,” saying Iran’s internal review process has not been completed; this directly contradicts Trump’s statement yesterday that “the war is over, deal reached.” Gains driven by yesterday’s peace-deal news were given back at the open: SPY opened higher at $740.7, then fell back to $737 within 11 minutes (-0.09%), QQQ -0.39%, while oil prices stabilized after stopping their decline (USO flat). The community count has reached “the 40th time for the same headline.”
  • ADBE earnings selloff continues: Q2 revenue $6.62B (+13%), EPS both beating expectations and full-year guidance raised, but CFO Dan Durn’s 6/15 departure (moving to MRVL), combined with CEO uncertainty, sent the stock down -7.7% at the open to $201.6; intraday low $197 broke below $200, entering its lowest zone since 2016, further reinforcing the “SaaS is dead” narrative; MRVL was also down -2.4%.
  • Single-stock divergence: MSFT -1.6% to $384, approaching its 9th/10th consecutive red daily candle, with community resentment maxed out; MU -2.7% to $970, continuing to give back gains from $982 (ahead of 6/24 earnings), SNDK +2.4% nearing $1950, while AMD bucked the trend +3% to $503, becoming the lone semiconductor survivor.

社区气氛：今天是WSB的“赌场圣诞节”——每个人都在观看SPCX开盘，情绪极其兴奋，但方向性却极度分裂：多头在第一天呼吁200-750美元，空头在开盘后排队买入看跌期权，而自嘲“我要在195美元的FOMO中说废话，然后在115美元止损”最能引起共鸣；对于大盘来说，伊朗协议再次被否决后，焦虑情绪明显上升，“抛售消息”成为主流解读。

恐惧/贪婪估计：贪婪7/10（集中在单一股票SPCX），恐惧5/10（太空股票持有者和软件股票持有者实际上正在遭受殴打），使整体情况成为“单点狂热+广泛焦虑”的扭曲组合。

情绪与实际市场行为：盘前，社会普遍预期“IPO日一定是绿的，大盘会得到支撑”，但实际上，开盘11分钟内，股指高开后回落，QQQ翻红，航天股暴跌，再次验证了WSB共识的逆势本质；然而SPCX本身还没有开始交易，所以今天真正的主战场还没有开启。
